report.summary: Consolidated verification reports: all claims are UNDECIDABLE due to missing source files. No CONFIRMED findings to action. Need to retrieve fitness-graph-delta.py and index-correctness.py to proceed.

risks.description: UNDECIDABLE: Claim 1 – inspect the 'literals' layer and how it uses repr() for string literals.
UNDECIDABLE: Claim 2 – access the corpus and mutation operator distribution.
UNDECIDABLE: Claim 3 – examine the leaky layer implementation and token handling.
UNDECIDABLE: Claim 4 – see the specificity arm implementation.
UNDECIDABLE: Claim 5 – review the code for SCORING_LAYERS and full corpus.
UNDECIDABLE: Claim 6 – look at the 'literals' layer logic.
UNDECIDABLE: Claim 7 – require the measure_commit function.
UNDECIDABLE: Claim 8 – require detection rate reporting code.

UNDECIDABLE: [risk] Silent type degradation: per-file type extraction is unconditional, so a layer-off build populates the cache; a subsequent layer-on build may hit the cache and skip resolution, yielding empty type_nodes/type_edges with no error.

UNDECIDABLE: [risk] Asymmetric truncation: _collect_docs and _collect each enforce max_files independently, so a repo with many docs may have docs truncated while code is fully indexed, producing a half-built index with no warning.
UNDECIDABLE: [risk] Wiki flag may be dead code: wiki_enabled is defined but not referenced in the provided excerpt; if build_index does not use it, the flag has no effect.
UNDECIDABLE: [risk] Cache key collision: if _scope_key omits wiki flag, a wiki-on build may reuse a wiki-off cache entry, losing wiki edges silently.
UNDECIDABLE: [todo] Ensure cache key includes types flag so layer-on builds do not reuse layer-off cache entries.
UNDECIDABLE: [todo] Add warning or unified limit when documents are truncated independently of code files.
UNDECIDABLE: [todo] Confirm wiki_enabled is actually wired into build_index; if missing, integrate it.
UNDECIDABLE: [todo] Verify _scope_key includes wiki flag; if not, add it.
